profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 8 years of experience in software development. Expertise in the complete lifecycle of software development including requirements definitions, analysis, implementation, testing and maintenance. Open to learning new technologies, characterized by fast learning and self-improvement. Able to work under pressure and cooperative team member.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Web applications and RESTful services were developed for several projects.
1. Some extensive RESTful APIs were developed with .NET Core, ASP.NET Web API 2, EF, SQL Server and TFS. The
services were consumed from web applications.
2. A few web applications were developed, technologies like Angular 6, Bootstrap 4, HTML5, CCS3 and Subversion
were used.
3. Unit and Integration Tests were performed to validate the correct working of the applications developed.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Development, maintenance and support of legacy software. New services were created for NCL-COM project.
1.	RESTful services were developed for the NCL-COM project. The services were consumed from web and mobile applications and were developed with Scala, Play Framework and MySQL.
2.	A web application was developed using Angular 8, AJAX, JSON, Bootstrap, HTML5 and CCS3.
3.	Unit and Integration Tests were performed to validate the correct working of the applications developed.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Maintenance of Windows Forms and Angular applications such as BEMS, FileNet and BemsClients. 

1.	RESTful APIs were supported using the following technologies: .NET Core, EF, SQL Server and SVN. 
2.	New functionalities were developed to improve the Loan process in the company using HTML5, Angular 6, Angular Material, CCS3 and Subversion.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Web applications and RESTful services were developed for Refunds and Transfers project.

1. RESTful services were developed with .NET Core, ASP.NET Web API 2, EF, SQL Server and Git. The services were consumed by a web application.
2. A web application was developed to allow HOAs make Refunds of Security Deposit and Transfers to residents. Technologies such as Angular 4, Bootstrap 3, HTML5 and CCS3 were used.
3. Unit and Integration Tests were performed to validate the correctness of the applications developed.
4. Scrum methodology supported by Azure DevOps and Continuous Integration were also used.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Web applications and RESTful services were developed for projects such as Absentee, Specialty Team and Bloomberg 2.0.
1.	An extensive RESTful API was developed with ASP.NET Web API 2, EF, SQL Server, Microsoft Azure and TFS. The services were consumed from web applications.
2.	A web application was developed to show important reports and Key Performance Indicators. Technologies like Angular 6, Bootstrap 4, HTML5, CCS3 and Subversion were used.
3.	Unit and Integration Tests were performed to validate the correct working of the applications developed.

positions.title: Team Lead
positions.description:
Services and functionalities were developed for mobile and web applications of projects such as the Sistema Nacional de Pagos and Plataforma de Cobros y Pagos. 
1.	An extensive RESTful API was developed with ASP.NET Web API, EF, SQL Server and TFS. The services were consumed from mobile and web applications.
2.	A web application was developed to allow customers to make interbank transfers and pay their bills. Technologies like ASP.NET MVC, AngularJS, JQuery, Bootstrap, HTML5 and CCS3 were used.
3.	Unit and Integration Tests were performed to validate the correct working of the applications developed. In addition, the Performance Tests executed by the QA team were supported.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Several versions of the PRIMICIA product were developed during the 3 years. SCRUM and its good practices were always used as software methodology. 
1.	A new version of the Administration subsystem was built using .NET Framework, Visual Basic, ASP.NET MVC, WCF and EF to allow editors and publishers to manage channel news. 
2.	A new News module was developed to allow editors and editors to create and edit news that was not possible before. Technologies like .NET Framework, ASP.NET MVC, JQuery and Bootstrap were used.
3.	The product PRIMICIA was deployed successfully in important places, such as Agencia de Información Nacional (AIN) in Havana and the Ministerio de Energía y Petróleo de Venezuela (MENPET).
4.	Others experimental works with PHP, Symfony 2, Doctrine, and SQLLite.
